64 direct public every() calls over List, Set, Map, Listing, and Mapping. The custom Java producer records all 21 ordinary raw row files, logger event count, and each logger event's level, message, module URI, member, and source position in UTF-8 and UTF-16BE. This target-only draft is not a tracked fixture or compatibility publication. It claims no Rust, native, browser, Node, full original-program, M2, or performance pass.
